'''August 1999 Vancouver tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Vancouver, British Columbia on 14 August 1999. Kevin W. won it. It is known from James Hsu's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d23">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-27-vancouver-british-columbia-8-14-99d23/ vancouver-british-columbia-8-14-99], DeckTech (James "Wraith One" Hsu, 27 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-27-vancouver-british-columbia-8-14-99d23/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Vancouver, British Columbia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 30
* '''Winner:''' Kevin W.
